3. The **size and density effects are dissociable**, so cell loss alone cannot account for the size phenotype.
4. A complete model should therefore predict — and could be tested by — whether blocking the presumed senescent-cell pathway in aged mice abolishes the shrinking effect, and whether the young-mouse enlargement depends on an off-target or systemic action rather than the canonical drug targets.
